description: Write a pause handoff mid-phase, then resume from it in a fresh session; assert the handoff file exists and the resume run exits cleanly.
why: Reality check RC20/R17: session persistence (pause/resume/handoff) is a headline claim with no scenario. Two single-turn model steps: /pan:pause must write .continue-here.md into the current phase directory (pause.md), /pan:resume-project must read it without error.

steps.why: pause.md: the handoff is written to .planning/phases/XX-name/.continue-here.md and committed.
resume-project reads the handoff and reports where work stopped; the phase name or number in its output is the evidence it read the right file.
